instruction: Convert the receipt image file /home/user/OIP.jpg to PDF format and save it as "receipt_archive.pdf" in the Downloads directory.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'receipt_archive.pdf' in Downloads. Evaluator checks /home/user/Downloads/receipt_archive.pdf has 1 page, proper size, and image content.
